items.summary: Financial recommendation: preserve only existing bounded work and authorize no new spend, monetization expansion, or queue actions this cycle. Revenue claims are not supported beyond $4.92 aggregate Amazon commission for 2026-09-21; site-attributed commission is $0 because the 629-click aggregate row cannot be assigned without inventing attribution. Contribution margin, ROI, CAC, payback, and cost-to-learn are not calculable: direct infrastructure, domains, labor, and experiment costs are unavailable, and revenue covers only one day while AI usage covers 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-23. AI usage is $759.78 across 4,529 calls, with 207 errors; this is an observability figure, not a complete infrastructure-cost ledger. The minimum finance measurement is a daily site/content ledger joining registered tracking ID, affiliate clicks/orders/shipped items/commission, GA4 sessions and conversions, AI cost, infrastructure/domain costs, and experiment exposure. Continue existing measurement gates and reject vanity metrics such as impressions, clicks, sessions, and SEO opportunity estimates unless they produce attributable revenue or validated learning.

SearchWoot must remain private from a finance perspective. No monetization or public-beta forecast is supportable until source rights, affiliate attribution, direct-cost inputs, and contribution-margin measurement are complete. The owner may choose among the existing disposition options; no outreach, spending, billing, credential, contract, or production action is authorized.

Existing Great American Lakes measurement may continue through its 14-day or 100-new-impression gate, but the observed 29 sessions, 1 conversion, and 1,533 impressions in the current observation do not establish revenue, margin, or causal lift because affiliate revenue is unavailable. Marineactivity.com and aliencouncil.com report-only baselines should remain report-only. Do not repeat failed or duplicate implementation work.
